preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The number of integers on the blackboard is between 6 and 1000, inclusive.
Each integer on the blackboard is between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of operations performed is between 0 and 11111, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(A_i in final_state and B_i in final_state and C_i in final_state for A_i, B_i, C_i in operations)
postconditions.description: Each operation uses integers that are present on the blackboard at the time of the operation.
All integers on the blackboard are reduced to 0 after the specified number of operations.
